subject: System Design
title: Feature Flags
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Feature Flags.

hook.text: Netflix deploys new code to production but only 1% of users see the new feature. That's a feature flag.

buildup.text: Feature flags wrap new functionality in an if-statement controlled by a configuration, not code.

discovery.text: Teams can deploy code daily and gradually roll out features, rolling back instantly if something breaks.

twist.text: Stale feature flags accumulate as technical debt. Without cleanup, codebases become tangled with dead branches.

climax.text: Feature flags decouple deployment from release, giving teams speed and safety simultaneously.

punchline.text: Deploy daily, release when you're ready.
